services.desc: Everyday Life - The art of Allen Sapp - An Intimate Understanding of the "Old Ways", Community, and Cree World View is the current exhibition at The Allen Sapp Gallery. The selection of works included in this exhibition depicts a way of life on the reserve, of men and women working alongside each other to provide comfort and sustenance for their community. It looks at everyday living, and the things that people do. The Original 80 - The Allen Sapp Gallery - The Gonor Collection is the current exhibition at The Allen Sapp Gallery.
